name: Captain America (Sam Wilson)

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Instant Rupture: Doğrudan hasar verir; anlık etkiler 0 saniyelik süreye sahiptir.
abilityDetails.Cowardice: Özel saldırı hasarını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Critical into Block: Blok sırasında alınan vuruşlar kritik olabilir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Özel saldırı kullanma — otomatik bloklar ve anında karşılık verir. Zırh kıran şampiyonlar avantajlı. Çok yetenek tetikleyen şampiyon kullanma, rupture ile karşılık verir.
signatureAbility:
Vibranium Enchanced Exo-8 Falcon
Redwing Lock-On lasts 2 second(s) longer, Attack Rating is increased by [498.65 - 3,989.23] and allows Captain America to inflict Ruptures from Special 2 through blocks.
When an Opponent Miss fails or when their Ability fails due to low Ability Accuracy, an instant Rupture is inflicted, dealing [498.65 - 2,991.86] Physical Damage. Damage scales with Base Attack only.
When either Champion performs a Well-Timed Block, Captain America inflicts a Sapped Charge on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Armor Up
content: When landing or being struck by a Basic Attack, 30% chance to gain a +[392.86] Armor Up Buff, lasting indefinitely up to 5 stacks. Additional stacks last for 15 seconds. These buffs turn into Passives when Nulified or Staggered, Start each fight with one of these Buffs.
While Armor Up is active, Captain America can trigger the Parry Mastery against non-contact attacks and he can block Unblockable Specials from mutants.
Each Armor Up reduces the Opponent's Bleed Ability Accuracy by -25% flat.

10% chance per Armor Up effect to Auto-Block incoming Special Attacks, up to 75%. The first time this Auto-Block is triggered against a Special Attack, it counts as a Well-Timed Block and removes all personal Armor-Ups.
Auto-Block Chance is also increased by 25% per Prowess effect on the Opponent. This chance is capped at 100% while the Opponent has Prowess.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Captain America cannot land Critical hits naturally, however every time he would have landed a Critical Hit he inflicts an instant Rupture, dealing Physical Damage. This ability scales with Critical Damage Rating.

Ruptures also inflict a Sapped Charge that lasts for 20 second(s), or indefinitely as a Defender. Consume all charges when reaching 20 stack(s), and replace them with a Power Drain Passive, draining 50% of the Opponent Power over 20 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Recon Scan
content: Dodging back and holding Block for 1.2 second(s), inflicting Lock-On charge for 16 second(s), but pauses on his Specials. Once Lock-On ends, it goes on Cooldown for 12 second(s). As a Defender, Cap inflicts a Lock-On Charge in 16 second(s) if not Locked-On.
When entering Lock-On, Cap passively inflicts Cowardice for the duration of Lock-On, reducing Special Attack damage by 40%.
While Locked-On, Cap gains [1,178.57] Critical Rating and his attacks cannot Miss
Striking the Opponent while Locked-On pauses Sapped charges for 5 second(s).

abilitySections.title: On a Heavy or Intercept
content: Consume an Armor Up Buff and gain a non-stacking +[1,178.57] Bulwark Buff for 15 seconds. While this Buff is active, Opponents have -100% Ability Accuracy when hitting Captain America's block.
Intercepts neither require nor consume an Armor-Up effect to activate Bulwark.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Last hit inflicts a [637.5] Physical Vulnerability Debuff for 30 seconds, paused while Locked-On. Max stacks 8.
Lock-On: Inflict 1 Sapped Charge.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain up to +[14,959.5] Attack Rating based on current Armor Rating until the end of the Special Attack. All but one personal Armor Ups are consumed by the end of the attack.
Armor Ups are paused.
Each hit inflicts a Rupture Debuff, dealing [1,994.6] Physical Damage over 10 second(s).
Lock-On: Each hit inflicts an extra instant Rupture Passive, dealing Critical Damage as Physical Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a Precision Buff, granting [11,000] Critical Rating for 8 second(s), but pauses for 0.5 second(s) on a Hit. Captain America can crit through blocks while this Buff is active.

Consume all but one personal Armor Up. While this Precision is active, gain a 10% chance for Armor Up consumed to inflict an extra Sapped Charge when inflicting a Rupture. Inflicting the Sapped Charges' Power Drain while this Precision is active restores the consumed Armor Ups.
Lock-On: Inflicts a Special Lock, preventing Specials from being activated for 10 second(s).
